# PowerPoint reference export

1. Open `../edge-cases.pptx` in Microsoft PowerPoint without repairing the file.
2. Export slides only, including the hidden-slide state in `reference.json`.
3. Export all visible slides as PDF with standard quality and no manual scaling.
4. Save the result here as `edge-cases.pdf`.
5. Record the PowerPoint version, macOS version, export date, Office file
   SHA-256, PDF SHA-256, visible slide count, total slide count, slide size, and
   installed fonts in `reference.json`.

The PDF is ground truth. Never replace it with a PDF generated by this viewer,
LibreOffice, or a visual-regression update command.
